Browsing: eating leaves and twigs of shrubs and trees (goats). Grazing: eating grass close to the ground (sheep, cattle).
Extra feeding for 2-3 weeks before and during mating to raise ovulation rate and the number of twins.
Cycle: doe about 21 days, ewe about 17 days; gestation about 150 days; wean at 3-4 months.
Young born ÷ females mated × 100 (can exceed 100% with twins).
Blood-sucking worm in the abomasum: anaemia (pale eyelids), bottle jaw, weakness; worst after wet seasons.
Keeps goats dry and clean: droppings fall through, less foot rot, pneumonia and worms.
